subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and should it use the reported `ignoreFileContent` name or a different canonical media-ingestion policy?
rationale: The reported key is not a current documented Feishu config contract, and adding it expands plugin config/default behavior in a channel that currently downloads inbound media by default.

options.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu per-account/top-level option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only file placeholders when disabled.

options.title: Use A Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Route Feishu through a broader channel media-ingestion setting if maintainers want one canonical attachment policy across channels.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Document that Feishu supports `mediaMaxMb` today but does not support a content-ignore switch, and close this request as not planned after maintainer approval.

recommendation.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu per-account/top-level option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only file placeholders when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the clearest recent Feishu media/docs history and is the best fit to choose the plugin policy shape.
